## Data PR Checklist (fill this in if Type = Scheme data)
- [ ] Official source URL is included below and is accessible
- [ ] Every eligibility rule has a source passage linked to it
- [ ] Source passage text is an exact quote from the official document
- [ ] Income values are in rupees as a number (e.g. `450000`, not `4.5 lakh`)
- [ ] Scheme status in the fixture is `draft` (not `published`)
- [ ] Retrieval date is recorded in the Source Document
- [ ] A second team member has verified the rules against the source
